entanglement.description: Resource access depends on package anchor resolution, Traversable path semantics, nested resource traversal, and text/binary mode behavior.
signals: files(anchor) resolves module objects and string module names.
joinpath accepts multiple segments and slash-separated nested paths.
read_text and read_binary preserve text encoding and byte payload behavior.
parent traversal must be rejected to avoid path leakage.

feature.description: Extract a Traversable package resource tree and text/binary readers without importing importlib_resources.
included_behaviors: module object and string anchor resolution
iterdir, is_file, is_dir, name, open, read_bytes, read_text
TraversalError for parent traversal and missing resources
